title: Sparkly castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground/hill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='10' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='8' fill='#43a047'/>

  <!-- main castle body -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='40' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='40' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- brick details -->
  <rect x='34' y='52' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='46' y='52' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='40' y='62' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='52' y='62' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>

  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='18' y='35' width='16' height='50' rx='2' fill='#cfd8dc'/>
  <rect x='18' y='35' width='16' height='50' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#eceff1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- left tower battlements -->
  <rect x='16' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='24' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='32' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>

  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='66' y='35' width='16' height='50' rx='2' fill='#cfd8dc'/>
  <rect x='66' y='35' width='16' height='50' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#eceff1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- right tower battlements -->
  <rect x='64' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='72' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='80' y='31' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#b0bec5'/>

  <!-- center tower top -->
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='20' height='17' rx='2' fill='#b0bec5'/>
  <rect x='40' y='28' width='20' height='17' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#cfd8dc' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- center battlements -->
  <rect x='38' y='24' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='47' y='24' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>
  <rect x='56' y='24' width='6' height='7' rx='1' fill='#90a4ae'/>

  <!-- roofs / flags -->
  <polygon points='26,31 26,20 26,31' fill='#e53935'/>
  <polygon points='74,31 74,20 74,31' fill='#e53935'/>
  <!-- left roof -->
  <polygon points='18,31 26,18 34,31' fill='#e53935'/>
  <polygon points='18,31 26,18 34,31' fill='none' stroke='#ef5350' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- right roof -->
  <polygon points='66,31 74,18 82,31' fill='#e53935'/>
  <polygon points='66,31 74,18 82,31' fill='none' stroke='#ef5350' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- center roof -->
  <polygon points='40,28 50,14 60,28' fill='#e53935'/>
  <polygon points='40,28 50,14 60,28' fill='none' stroke='#ef5350' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- flags -->
  <rect x='25' y='10' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  <polygon points='26.5,10 34,12.5 26.5,15' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <rect x='49' y='6' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  <polygon points='50.5,6 58,8.5 50.5,11' fill='#ffeb3b'/>
  <rect x='73' y='10' width='1.5' height='10' fill='#ffb74d'/>
  <polygon points='74.5,10 82,12.5 74.5,15' fill='#ffeb3b'/>

  <!-- gate -->
  <path d='M44 85 L44 70 Q50 62 56 70 L56 85 Z' fill='#5d4037'/>
  <path d='M44 85 L44 70 Q50 62 56 70 L56 85 Z' fill='none' stroke='#8d6e63' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- gate details -->
  <line x1='50' y1='65' x2='50' y2='85' stroke='#795548' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='1.5' fill='#ffb74d'/>

  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x='36' y='55' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <rect x='59' y='55' width='5' height='7' rx='1' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <rect x='24' y='45' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <rect x='71' y='45' width='4' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffe082'/>
  <rect x='46' y='38' width='4' height='5' rx='1' fill='#ffe082'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <!-- top left sparkle -->
  <g fill='#ffee58'>
    <polygon points='10,20 12,26 18,28 12,30 10,36 8,30 2,28 8,26'/>
  </g>
  <!-- top right sparkle -->
  <g fill='#ffee58'>
    <polygon points='88,15 90,21 96,23 90,25 88,31 86,25 80,23 86,21'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle left -->
  <g fill='#fff9c4'>
    <polygon points='8,52 9.5,56 13.5,57.5 9.5,59 8,63 6.5,59 2.5,57.5 6.5,56'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small sparkle right -->
  <g fill='#fff9c4'>
    <polygon points='90,48 91.5,52 95.5,53.5 91.5,55 90,59 88.5,55 84.5,53.5 88.5,52'/>
  </g>
  <!-- top center sparkle -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <polygon points='50,2 51.5,7 56.5,8.5 51.5,10 50,15 48.5,10 43.5,8.5 48.5,7'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='10' r='1.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='1' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='65' r='1' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='6' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
</svg>
